title: Police union Alliance protests at Interior Ministry for higher risk pay
seoTitle: Paris police union protest at ministry

tea.why: Police officers are protesting to demand better pay and an increase in their risk premium, citing exhaustion and injuries from recent duty.
tea.want: An immediate 35% increase in the risk premium (ISSP), salary adjustments for administrative staff, and a review of scientific police status.
tea.changed: Nov 18: A delegation led by Alliance secretary general Fabien Vanhemelryck met with Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez to discuss demands.

summary: On November 18, 2026, dozens of police officers gathered outside the Ministry of the Interior in Paris for a surprise protest organized by the Alliance police union. The demonstrators demanded an immediate 35% increase in their risk premium (ISSP), arguing that current government proposals are insufficient. Union representatives highlighted the strain on police forces following weeks of social unrest and student protests, noting that over 2,500 officers have been injured in the last five weeks. A delegation led by Alliance secretary general Fabien Vanhemelryck met with Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez during the protest. While the minister reportedly offered a 33.5% increase spread over three years, the union rejected this as inadequate. The union also called for salary improvements for administrative personnel and reforms to the status of the scientific police.
response: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez met with an Alliance delegation and proposed a 33.5% increase in the risk premium spread over three years, which the union rejected as insufficient.

updates.text: Dozens of police officers held a surprise protest outside the Interior Ministry in Paris to demand pay increases.
A delegation from the Alliance union met with Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez to present their demands.
